task: G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-39 roof mounts out of reach of ground melee/demolition
rule: Out of reach = hit whose weapon class is in rules roof7.out_of_reach_classes (content/g7/rules_g7_roof.json, default [melee, demolition]) from a NON-AIR shooter (Content unit is_air or move_class air*), against a building def with roof_mount:true (cn_ciws7). Why: every ground weapon with contact reach (<=1.5 tiles) is class melee/demolition (g6_claw, g5 melee, g4_charge, g6_satchel, g6_shaped_charge, g5_breach/g5_takedown); the others that short are artillery-class mine/warhead blasts and g6_mimic_dive (air_low drone). Flame (3.5-6 tiles) keeps reach; add 'flame' to the list to change.
